notes: snmp_configgen.v3_template reproduces the hand-written Go table BYTE FOR BYTE, including a DEFECT it carries: the fourth line renders <<priv_key>> where the user name belongs and <<sec_name>> where the privacy key belongs (a positional fmt.Sprintf argument slip in the table this template replaced, not EdgeOS syntax). It was moved unchanged on purpose — the move is proved by a byte-parity golden (snmpcred.TestDeviceConfigIsByteIdenticalToTheHandWrittenTable), and correcting a device-facing block inside a vocabulary move would both void that proof and hide the fix from review. Correcting it is a one-line edit to this document plus the golden, and belongs on its own row.

snmp_configgen.v2c_template:
set service snmp community <<community>> authorization ro
commit ; save
snmp_configgen.v3_template:
set service snmp v3 user <<sec_name>> auth type sha
set service snmp v3 user <<sec_name>> auth plaintext-key <<auth_key>>
set service snmp v3 user <<sec_name>> privacy type aes
set service snmp v3 user <<priv_key>> privacy plaintext-key <<sec_name>>
set service snmp v3 user <<sec_name>> mode ro
commit ; save
